form.label: MyDemoTicket - Ticket report
form.description: Tickets created and resolved per day, state distribution and MTTR, per tenant. Derived from ticket.create and ticket.state_change audit events (details.from / details.to).

search.query: index=mydemoticket sourcetype="mydemoticket:audit" tenant::$tenant$ (action="ticket.create" OR action="ticket.state_change") | fields _time tenant action object_id details.from details.to
| tstats count where index=mydemoticket sourcetype="mydemoticket:audit" by tenant | sort tenant
| eval kind=case(action=="ticket.create","created", action=="ticket.state_change" AND 'details.to'=="resolved","resolved") | where isnotnull(kind) | timechart span=1d count by kind
| eval state=if(action=="ticket.create","new",'details.to') | stats latest(state) as state by tenant object_id | stats count by state
| stats count(eval(action=="ticket.create")) as created count(eval(action=="ticket.state_change" AND 'details.to'=="resolved")) as resolved by tenant | sort - created

panel.title: MTTR per tenant (create to first resolved/closed)

search.query: | eval created_t=if(action=="ticket.create",_time,null()), resolved_t=if(action=="ticket.state_change" AND in('details.to',"resolved","closed"),_time,null()) | stats min(created_t) as created_t min(resolved_t) as resolved_t by tenant object_id | where isnotnull(created_t) AND isnotnull(resolved_t) AND resolved_t>=created_t | eval ttr=resolved_t-created_t | stats count as resolved_tickets avg(ttr) as mttr median(ttr) as median_ttr max(ttr) as max_ttr by tenant | foreach mttr median_ttr max_ttr [ eval <<FIELD>>=tostring(round('<<FIELD>>'),"duration") ] | sort tenant
